blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 at finalized Solana slot 437980139. The sole tracked HYUSD mint remains owned by the legacy SPL Token program with freezeAuthority = null; pinned Token Program source requires the current freeze authority to freeze an account and does not permit a disabled authority to be restored. Hylo identifies no separate issuer transfer-control layer. Current reviewed pool composition includes 5.319864% Circle USDC plus dust cbBTC exposure. Circle can freeze that reserve asset and impair backing or conversions, but cannot freeze HYUSD token accounts; the matched reserve exposure is below the v3.9973 >50% upstream threshold.

oracleRisk.summary: The observable V1 program uses Sanctum LST accounting and Pyth SOL/USD, while current V2 documentation specifies independent SOL/USD, BTC/USD, and USDC/USD paths. Hylo's address directory does not publish a complete deployed V2 program/pool inventory, so the production oracle graph is unresolved.

branchApplicability.rationale: Hylo unquestionably consumes price and value inputs: the observable V1 design uses Pyth EMA SOL/USD and Sanctum LST accounting to calculate hyUSD NAV and the reserve ratio. However, current documentation also specifies isolated per-asset V2 oracle paths while the published address directory still identifies only the V1 deployment, so the production single-path versus market-specific branch topology cannot be resolved from the reviewed sources.
